captions.text: Excel just broke one of its oldest rules.
For decades, one cell basically meant one value.
In Excel Beta, one cell can now hold a real list — like three project owners.
Excel can treat those items separately, filter them, and spill the values back out.
Microsoft is also adding functions like HAS and FLATTEN for this model.
It is still a preview — but this changes what an Excel cell can be.
